description: Source code for remote cluster file transfer service in Mattermost, including functions for sending files asynchronously to remote clusters, handling HTTP requests, and managing file uploads.

classes.name: sendFileTask
classes.description: Struct representing a task to send a file to a remote cluster, including remote cluster info, upload session, file info, reader provider, and callback function.

methods.name: SendFile
methods.description: Asynchronously enqueues a task to send a file to a remote cluster, with context control and optional callback.

methods.name: sendFile
methods.description: Handles the actual sending of a file to a remote cluster when a sendFileTask is dequeued.

methods.name: sendFileToRemote
methods.description: Performs the HTTP POST request to upload the file to the remote cluster and processes the response.
